events.title: The upcoming international fixtures mean that there is no action in the Premier League this weekend, but it is business as usual in the Football League. Newly-promoted 버밍엄 시티 win 5–0 at 반즐리 in Division One. 밀월 go top of the table with a 1–0 win over 포츠머스 at Fratton Park . 셰필드 유나이티드 's 3–1 defeat at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 leaves them bottom of the table and still looking for their first point of the season after five games.

In a rematch of last season's FA Cup Final , 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 에버턴 3–2. Lee Sharpe scores twice, and former United player Andrei Kanchelskis is taken off with a dislocated shoulder, ruling him out for the next few weeks. United are now level on points with leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who lose 1–0 at 사우샘프턴. 윔블던 go third with a 1–0 home win over 리버풀. In Division One, 셰필드 유나이티드 pick up their first points of the season with a 2–1 home win over 노리치 시티.
A London derby at Upton Park sees 첼시 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–1.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain level on points at the top of the Premier League after both managing home victories. 애스턴 빌라 move into third place with a 2–0 home win over 윔블던.

요크 시티 defeat an under-strength 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–0 in the League Cup second-round first leg at Old Trafford . This will ultimately prove to be the only home defeat all season in any competition for the hosts.

맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the Premier League after drawing 0–0 at 셰필드 웬즈데이. Defending champions 블랙번 로버스 snap out of a recent run of dismal form and defeat 코번트리 시티 5–1 at Ewood Park with Alan Shearer scoring a hat-trick. 리버풀 remain third after a 5–2 home win over Bolton. Tony Yeboah scored a hat-trick for Leeds in a 4–2 win at 윔블던. 맨체스터 시티 are bottom of the table with one point from their first seven games, losing 1–0 at home to 미들즈브러 today.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go back to the top of the Premier League with a 2–0 home win over 첼시.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are knocked out of the UEFA Cup on away goals after drawing 2–2 at home to Russian side Rotor Volgograd in the first round second leg, but still maintain their 39-year unbeaten run in European competitions following a late equaliser by goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel - the club's first goalkeeper to score a goal in any competitions since Alex Stepney in 1973.

맨체스터 시티's terrible start to the season continues with a 3–0 defeat at 노팅엄 포리스트, which makes it one point from their first eight league games. 애스턴 빌라 go second with a 3–0 away win over their former manager Ron Atkinson 's new club 코번트리 시티.
